title: Cart reducer
hints: `switch (action.type)` — inside each `case`, TypeScript narrows `action` to that one variant, so `action.line` only exists in `case "add"`. Finish with `default: { const unreachable: never = action; return unreachable; }`.
Never mutate: return `{ lines: ... }` built with `map`, `filter` or spread. For "add", first check `state.lines.some((l) => l.id === action.line.id)`.

"add" existing → `state.lines.map((l) => l.id === id ? { ...l, qty: l.qty + 1 } : l)`; new → `[...state.lines, { ...action.line, qty: 1 }]`. "setQty" with `qty <= 0` → reuse the "remove" logic (`filter`).
